Homebrew: automated the same way the official Dragon Breath (Dragon Form) action is — clickable area-template and damage-roll links in the text below. As with Dragon Breath, the Reflex save against your spell DC isn't automated and is resolved manually.

Each creature in a @Template[type:cone|distance:60] takes @Damage[15d6[untyped]|options:area-damage] damage, with a basic save against your spell DC. Once activated, it can't be used again for [[/r 1d4 #Recharge Breath Weapon]]{1d4 rounds}.
